name: Yellowstone National Park
description: Home to Old Faithful and abundant wildlife, Yellowstone is famous for its geysers, hot springs, and dramatic canyons.

name: Grand Canyon National Park
description: One of the world's most spectacular landscapes, carved by the Colorado River over millions of years.

name: Yosemite National Park
description: Known for towering granite cliffs, waterfalls, and giant sequoia groves in California's Sierra Nevada.

name: Zion National Park
description: Steep red-rock canyon walls and the Virgin River make Zion a favorite for hikers and canyoneers.

name: Great Smoky Mountains National Park
description: The most visited national park in the U.S., known for misty mountain ridges and rich biodiversity.

name: Acadia National Park
description: Rocky Atlantic coastline, woodlands, and granite peaks make Acadia a favorite New England getaway.
